manifest.name: work-task
manifest.description: A unit of human follow-up work arising from a business event, held against an opaque subject envelope. Every field is managed: a task exists only through the work package's actions or its follow-up capability, and no client can create, forge or rewrite one. It has an explicit transition table (open -> completed, open -> cancelled; both terminal, no reopen in v1) and no assignee: there is no authenticated or secure assignment here. dueAt is evidence only -- nothing is scheduled, nothing fires, and no clock changes a status.

migrations.name: create_work_tasks
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS work_tasks (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  title TEXT,
  status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('open', 'completed', 'cancelled')),
  due_at TEXT,
  subject_resource TEXT,
  subject_id TEXT,
  subject_owner TEXT CHECK(subject_owner IN ('host', 'package')),
  subject_owner_package TEXT,
  subject_label TEXT,
  source_package TEXT,
  source_action TEXT,
  opened_by_type TEXT CHECK(opened_by_type IN ('user', 'agent', 'system')),
  opened_by_id TEXT,
  opened_at TEXT,
  completed_by TEXT,
  completed_at TEXT,
  cancelled_by TEXT,
  cancelled_at TEXT,
  closing_reason TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS work_tasks_status ON work_tasks(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS work_tasks_subject_resource ON work_tasks(subject_resource);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS work_tasks_subject_id ON work_tasks(subject_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS work_tasks_source_package ON work_tasks(source_package);

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_work_tasks
bootstrap.sql:

CREATE TABLE "accordo"."work_tasks" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "source_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "title" TEXT,
  "status" TEXT CHECK("status" IN ('open', 'completed', 'cancelled')),
  "due_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "subject_resource" TEXT,
  "subject_id" TEXT,
  "subject_owner" TEXT CHECK("subject_owner" IN ('host', 'package')),
  "subject_owner_package" TEXT,
  "subject_label" TEXT,
  "source_package" TEXT,
  "source_action" TEXT,
  "opened_by_type" TEXT CHECK("opened_by_type" IN ('user', 'agent', 'system')),
  "opened_by_id" TEXT,
  "opened_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "completed_by" TEXT,
  "completed_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "cancelled_by" TEXT,
  "cancelled_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "closing_reason" TEXT,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX "work_tasks_status"
  ON "accordo"."work_tasks"("status");

CREATE INDEX "work_tasks_subject_resource"
  ON "accordo"."work_tasks"("subject_resource");

CREATE INDEX "work_tasks_subject_id"
  ON "accordo"."work_tasks"("subject_id");

CREATE INDEX "work_tasks_source_package"
  ON "accordo"."work_tasks"("source_package");
